items.actionable_item: CMMS golden file require to be updated during NPI for flawless operation without part mixing risk.
items.description: CMMS Golden file need to be tracked for all product
items.scenario: 1. TEGt owned xRB, CA owned by TED

items.actionable_item: Optimize Deactuate Work Flow with function check V3 valve.
items.description:
CX1 de-actuate WF optimize enable function check valve V3 ( if having sensor) trigger. Alarm pop up when deactuate wf fail. WP link: "HDMx MTLU281&MTLH682 de-actuate workflow optimization and update recipe [Class IV]". WP mentioned can proliferation this pratice for other CX1 products.
http://xccb2.intel.com/Documents/DocumentWorkspace.aspx?DocumentID=2134537
items.scenario: 2. Module owned xRB, CA own by TRB

items.actionable_item: Enhance EGDI conversion procedure to replace Gasket in CX1 AP
items.description: Apply for all CX1 AP when doing EGDI conversion
items.scenario: who will hold accountable as project lead?

items.actionable_item: HDMX personality card wrongly. Retire PC rev 02 ( CDAT action). Control method at VNAT: Follow golden file tracking during conversion and repair
items.description: RPLP282 TIU RPLP213T1461 wrongly used ADLP282 personality card (PC). Applicable for RPL and ADLP (CX1)

items.actionable_item: Distinguish collateral name for product which have multiple process use using different physical collateral ( LNL, PTL) has BGA&LGA TIU, AP by TP check naming convention
items.description: To prevent cell testing if mistakenly wrong physical AP or TIU. TP check collateral name and trigger alarm ( Products based)

items.actionable_item: Verify pogo-pin max current specification vs. max drawn current by TP demand
items.description: Tp Claim limit higher than ADLM282 pogo pin ( 144G3). Pogo pin change to prevent burnt pin as TP current limit higher than pogo pin capability (refer bin 9901)

items.actionable_item: Enable PCS for VCC MEASUREMENT FIVR_VLOAD_VCCVDDQ (or equivalent test name) to detect out of range or stuck value
items.description: Learning from ADL/RPL product family which observed stuck value (stuck at <0 instead of normal positive value) in VCC VLOAD measurement due to HW marginality. For any NPI product, PdO needs to check with TP owner (RPE/MPE) the test name and TP kill limit. PCS control limit can be based on TP Kill limit (parametric or bin-based) or statistical limit.

items.actionable_item: Enable PCS MainPedTemp and MainRtdTemp0 Monitoring To Prevent Burnt AP Heater
items.description: Applied for all ADL, RPL products and onwards

items.actionable_item: Enable Sub-app SI-E-SUB-B-STDR (BGA products stain on ball)
items.description: POR subapp to catch  LTIM stain on substrate ballside (developed by TD from MTLU281 onward), target replace E-App FMDR1
E-subapp to catch LTIM stain on substrate ballside with PyPCS E-app enable, applicable for ADLP/ RPLP.  Other bare die follow STDR sub app (Sub-app SI-E-SUB-B-STDR)

items.actionable_item: E-subapp SI-E-SUB-T-STAIN (BGA products transparent stain on sub)
items.description: E-subapp to catch transparent stain on substrate with CSR or PyPCS enable for CA trigger.

items.actionable_item: Enable PCS_STIM_LTIM_PUSH_2 (Detection of TSP bare die prods LTIM push regulator failed)
items.description: To prevent LTIM push regulator fail while running at tool. Applicable for TSP bare die (TSP lid product have LTIM shield so have no issue), condension prevention -TSP: LTIM push to flow air/ CX1: Vacuum valve, if design use vacuum valve connect to sensor V3 then move to action in col "PCS_STIM_MainAinVoltage_2_Max", if not V3, high risk - run to fail)

items.actionable_item: PCS_STIM_MainAinVoltage_2_Max (Detection of CX1 Vacuum V3 failed)
items.description: Detection of Vacuum V3 failed (applicable for products run with CX1 Pan use V3) - Required: pedestal vacuum connect to sensor V3 / Module recipe logged token - based on pedestal design, if not V3 connected, high risk - run to fail - TRB request
